hook.name: OrketHook
hook.description: A prediction market hook implementing VALS (Volatility-Adjusted Liquidity-Sensitive) fees. Each swap requires a fresh ECDSA-signed volatility parameter (sigma) from a trusted signer; the fee is computed as e^(λ·Δx/L·σ)−1 and forwarded to a YieldDistributor for share holders rather than LPs. Swaps and liquidity additions are blocked when the market is resolved or disputed.
